task: Three original concepts, then generate the mechanical hound in Tripo.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production concept art and image-to-3D input for a small top-down fantasy action game. Create one isolated complete object on a plain warm white background, no text, labels, diagram, multiple views, platform, ground geometry or other characters. Clean precise semi-realistic game concept rendering, believable manufactured hard surfaces with lightly painterly material richness. Strong silhouette and broad readable surfaces, moderate wear, not excessive tiny greebles. Aged warm brass edges and hardware, deep dark teal enamel panels, dark iron hinges, small turquoise luminous power cores, soft neutral studio lighting. Entire object fully visible with a generous margin. Mechanically explicit seams and separated rigid moving parts, not organic flesh. Single three-quarter view with near-orthographic perspective. Subject: a fast clockwork hunting hound, a slim long greyhound-shaped four-legged machine. Body about 95cm long, shoulder height 50cm, head raised to 62cm. Long low deep rib cage, dramatically tucked-up slim waist and slender pelvic module; elegant athletic legs, not a bulky tank or stocky dog. Brass rib armor plates wrap a deep teal spinal frame. One modest wind-up key on the upper back. Long narrow flattened trap-shaped muzzle with a separate lower jaw opened about 20 degrees, a few clearly visible interlocking triangular metal teeth. A SINGLE turquoise optic centered across its narrow forehead, two short thin antenna ears. Exactly four articulated legs, each with separate upper limb, lower limb and compact paw, distinct cylindrical hinges, one simple piston per leg with an exposed rod. The four paws rest naturally on the same level but slightly staggered so all four legs can be traced without overlap. View mostly from its left side with some front showing; head to left, rump to right. Two-segment thin rigid antenna tail extends behind the rump with a tiny turquoise tip; clear white gap between tail and body. Alert neutral standing pose suitable for later rigging. No motion blur, no smoke, no decorative cables connecting legs, no additional weapons or extra armor variant.

Deployed neutral pose, light on but no glow cloud or flare, no concentric sound rings, no gun barrel, no smoke or magical particles.
